# SEBAMOX — Sebastiano Mollo

> Portfolio of Sebastiano Mollo (brand: SEBAMOX), Creative Developer and Frontend
> Engineer, Computer Engineering student. Custom premium websites, interactive
> web experiences, and full-stack architectures built from scratch — no templates.

Sebamox is the personal portfolio and studio site of Sebastiano Mollo. It presents
production client work alongside low-level engineering case studies: a 2D game
engine written in C, a CPU-only software 3D rasterizer, a WebAssembly optimization
algorithm targeting 1980s hardware, and premium React front-ends with GSAP and
Canvas-driven scroll sequences.

The site is written in Italian (`it-IT`). It is a React single-page application
with statically pre-rendered `<head>` metadata for every route, so crawlers that
do not execute JavaScript still receive correct titles, descriptions, and images.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://sebamox.dev/): Overview of services, technology stack, process, pricing tiers, and FAQ.
- [Archivio Progetti / Works](https://sebamox.dev/works): Full project archive — six case studies spanning interactive front-end, full-stack, graphics, and systems programming.
- [Contatti / Contact](https://sebamox.dev/contact): Project enquiry page and direct contact channels.

## Projects

- [villaKoi](https://sebamox.dev/projects/VillaKoi): Full-stack Zen-inspired web experience. React front-end with GSAP ScrollTrigger, Python/FastAPI backend.
- [Forge Engine](https://sebamox.dev/projects/c-game-engine): 2D platformer game engine written from scratch in pure C, with Raylib as the only dependency.
- [Software 3D Engine](https://sebamox.dev/projects/software-3d-engine): CPU-only 3D rendering engine in pure C — perspective projection, matrix math, and rasterization without a GPU.
- [ZX Spectrum AI Engine](https://sebamox.dev/projects/zx-spectrum): Stochastic optimization algorithm in native C compiled to WebAssembly, pushed against 1980s hardware limits.
- [Aurora Skeletonized](https://sebamox.dev/projects/aeon-camera): Haute horlogerie scroll experience — a 240-frame Canvas sequence scrubbed frame-by-frame against scroll position.

## Services

- Custom websites — bespoke front-end architecture, zero templates
- E-commerce — friction-free checkout, conversion-oriented UX
- Landing pages — brief to live in 48h
- Web apps & SaaS — dashboards and client portals
- Brand identity — logotype, palette, typography, digital-first
- Technical SEO & Core Web Vitals — Lighthouse scores above 90

## Technologies

- **Front-end:** React 19, JavaScript, TypeScript, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, CSS/SCSS
- **Animation & 3D:** GSAP (ScrollTrigger), Three.js, React Three Fiber, WebGL, GLSL, Spline, Lenis, Framer Motion, Matter.js, Canvas 2D
- **Back-end:** Python, FastAPI, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs
- **Systems & low-level:** C, C++, SDL2, Raylib, WebAssembly, MATLAB
- **Infrastructure:** Vercel, static pre-rendering, Vercel Analytics

## Topics

- Creative development and interactive web experiences
- Frontend engineering and UI engineering
- Scroll-driven animation and Canvas frame sequences
- Real-time 3D on the web and custom rendering engines
- Full-stack architecture with Python and React
- Web performance, Core Web Vitals, and technical SEO
- Game engine and graphics programming in C
- Computer engineering studies and systems programming
